description: (Na)₂KRhF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a KRhF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the KRhF₆ framework, K is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form KF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent RhF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All K-F bond lengths are 2.45 Å. Rh is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form RhF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent KF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Rh-F bond lengths are 2.00 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one K and one Rh atom.
